mapper.select: select coalesce(max(id), 0) from reward_drop_log where scene_key = 'roam_merchant_poi' and drop_type in (1, 3)

select d.id, d.member_id as memberId from reward_drop_log d left join roam_reward_delivery i on i.drop_log_id = d.id where d.scene_key = 'roam_merchant_poi' and d.drop_type in (1, 3) and d.id > #{afterId} and d.id <= #{throughId} and (i.drop_log_id is null or i.state = 'DUE') order by d.id asc limit #{limit}
